findings.message: 'verdict' is deliberately split across two printf calls (`printf 'verd'; printf 'ict'`) specifically to evade the coercion-vocabulary grep guard in review-aggregator-test.sh SPEC-3; the design document directs removing the token from the guard, but the implementation circumvents the guard instead, leaving SPEC-3 passing while it no longer enforces its stated constraint — any future coercion token that also happens to spell the same word via fragmentation will pass undetected.
